paragraph: A pub owner in the English town of Knaresborough spent thousands of pounds on a large festive light display. He wanted to cheer up the locals during a particularly tough year. Residents there have faced a turbulent time as the cost of living soared. The bright lights now decorate the picturesque streets for the Christmas season. The town has a bit of extra glow tonight.
